== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100675 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100675], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100675-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>afcbe71c46a4c0d8ae75fa8aabbae041f3d775316d84b655731c36e288fa301f</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
